hero.subtext: I am a Systems Analyst and Back-End Developer specialized in building highly-available Automations and Services.

about.p1: My name is Atyla (pronounced Ah-tee-la) — I'm primarily a Back-End developer, but I have extensive experience working with Front-End tools and frameworks.
about.p2: I hold a degree in Systems Analysis and Development, and I specialize in building Automations, REST APIs, Services, Third-Party Software Integrations, and Database Management.
about.p3: I'm also skilled in building Dynamic Reports with Power BI, Excel, and more.
about.p4: My English is fluent, and I have a strong affinity for documentation and clean, readable code.

services.header: Translation services to help you<breakline/><highlight>reach your audience</highlight>.

proofreading.title: Proofreading
proofreading.description: Already got something translated, but you're not sure if it's grammatically and syntactically cohesive, or even if it is logically coherent? I can Proofread anything for you and help you get your ideas across in a professional and natural-sounding manner.

captioning.title: Video Captioning
captioning.description: Want your YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram videos to reach an overseas audience? I can caption your videos in both English and Portuguese

interpreting.title: Interpreting
interpreting.description: Got a Video call booked with a client, but can't speak a word of their language? I can interpret your conversation live, in real time.
